title: PATTERSON UTI ENERGY INC 8-K Filing — 2026-04-28
summary: Patterson-UTI Energy, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on April 24, 2026 (signed April 28, 2026) announcing an amendment to its Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement. The amendment extends the maturity date for $450 million of revolving credit commitments from January 31, 2030 to January 31, 2031, and reassigns $25 million of revolving credit commitments from HSBC Bank USA, N.A. to JPMorgan Chase Bank, N.A. This is a corporate credit facility amendment for an oilfield services company and has no relevance to market structure or macro catalysts.
key_points: Patterson-UTI Energy filed Form 8-K on April 24, 2026 announcing Amendment No. 1 to Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement
Amendment extends maturity date for $450 million of revolving credit commitments from January 31, 2030 to January 31, 2031

Wells Fargo Bank, National Association serves as administrative agent
Credit Agreement was originally dated January 31, 2025
Filed by Executive Vice President and CFO C. Andrew Smith on April 28, 2026
